description: Defines test utilities for QUIC protocol, including a packet writer implementation and functions to generate initial packet sequences for testing.

classes.name: DelegatedPacketWriter
classes.description: A QuicPacketWriter implementation that delegates packet sending to a user-provided delegate.

methods.name: GetFirstFlightOfPackets
methods.description: Generates a sequence of packets representing the first flight of a real HTTP/3 connection, with various overloads for default parameters.

methods.name: GetAnnotatedFirstFlightOfPackets
methods.description: Generates annotated packet sequences with additional session information.
